reporte.curiosity: A real solar storm reached Mars on May 20, 2024. Nobody lived there: Curiosity measured a dose that NASA says would have been about 8,100 ?Gy for a person standing next to the rover, equivalent to around 30 chest X-rays. This is a historical reference, not a measurement of your crew.
reporte.pronostico: The coronal mass ejection of {fecha} was real. The forecast of its arrival near Earth was off by {horas} hours. This is an Earth observation, not a forecast for Mars.
reporte.pronosticoNoDisponible: There is not enough data to compare this event?s forecast.
reporte.consejo: One idea to explore: prepare the shielding and get the crew to the shelter early, because storms can arrive sooner than expected.
